Appearance:
 Shri Bhupendra Kumar Mishra - Advocate for the petitioners  Shri Swapnil Ganguly - Government Advocate for the respond  ORDER

This petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking the following reliefs :-
"I. Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondent No.3 to decide/consider the representation of the Petitioners produced as Annexure P/5. II.

Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondents to grant the proper compensation to the petitioners along with 12% interest per annum as acquired the land as soon as possible properly on the basis of irrigated land in pursuance of notification (P/6).
III. Issue any other writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble Court deems fit."
It appears that the petitioner is aggrieved by the amount of compensation awarded by the Land Acquisition Officer.

In view of provision under section 64 of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, this Court is of considered opinion that this petition 2 WP-21743-2024 is not maintainable.
